name: Device adapter for SM80 universal GEMM
summary: Wrap an Ampere universal GEMM kernel with host-side capability checks, workspace management, parameter initialization, update, and CUDA-stream launch operations.

strategy.intent: Provide a stable device-level lifecycle around interchangeable SM80 GEMM kernels.
strategy.mechanism: Delegate problem validation and parameter conversion to the kernel, manage required workspace, and launch the initialized operation on a caller-provided stream.
strategy.expected_benefit: Separates kernel selection and device orchestration from low-level threadblock implementation details.
tradeoffs: Kernel and adapter contracts must remain type-compatible.
Workspace requirements vary with execution mode and scheduler.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: Problem, tensor, stride, mode, and epilogue arguments.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: CUDA stream for initialization and execution.

constraints.rationale: The adapter calls kernel-defined argument, parameter, validation, and workspace interfaces.
Required temporary storage must be available before initialization.
Alignment, shape, and mode requirements must be checked before launch.

references.evidence: The adapter supplies capability checks, workspace sizing, initialization, argument updates, and stream-aware execution.
